name: Agiliron
description_en:
Agiliron connects multichannel selling with inventory, warehouse operations, CRM and point of sale. Its scope includes B2B and B2C commerce, with accounting connections around the operational record.

A sensible evaluation follows one SKU from a supplier receipt to a warehouse location and then through both a store sale and an online order. The important question is whether channel quantities and fulfillment records stay consistent under the business’s own rules.
description_zh:
Agiliron 将多渠道销售与库存、仓库作业、CRM 和 POS 连接起来，覆盖 B2B 与 B2C，并在运营记录周围提供会计连接。

评估时可跟踪一个 SKU：从供应商收货入库，到门店销售与线上订单出库，检查各渠道数量与履约记录是否符合企业自身规则。

core_features.explanation_en: The detailed feature page describes mobile picking, receiving and cycle counts, plus product creation and images.
core_features.explanation_zh: 详细功能页列出移动拣货、收货、循环盘点及商品创建和图片功能。

core_features.explanation_en: The suite covers store POS and online B2B/B2C channels alongside inventory.
core_features.explanation_zh: 套件在库存之外覆盖门店 POS 及线上 B2B/B2C 渠道。

sections.title_en: Test a shared SKU across store and online sales
sections.title_zh: 测试门店与线上共用 SKU
sections.en: Set up product identifiers, opening quantities and warehouse locations before connecting selling channels. Receive a small purchase, pick an online order and record a POS sale against the same item. Then count the remaining stock and inspect discrepancies rather than treating a successful import as proof that every channel is synchronized. This is a proposed evaluation sequence, not a completed implementation.
sections.zh: 先设置商品标识、期初数量与仓位，再连接销售渠道。用小批采购收货、线上拣货和同一商品的 POS 销售做测试，最后盘点余量并检查差异。导入成功不足以证明所有渠道已同步。这是建议的评估顺序，尚未实际实施。

sections.en: The pricing page lists Premier, Enterprise and Global Enterprise. A flattened feature comparison does not reliably establish that every listed capability is included in every edition. Ask for an edition-specific confirmation of required warehouse functions, accounting connectors and B2B capabilities before migration.
sections.zh: 价格页列出 Premier、Enterprise 与 Global Enterprise。文本化对照表无法可靠证明所有列出的功能均包含在每个版本中；迁移前应取得所需仓库功能、会计连接及 B2B 能力的版本级确认。

sections.title_en: Budget for users, channels and implementation
sections.title_zh: 核算用户、渠道与实施费用
sections.en: Published monthly prices are $99, $199 and $299 respectively; annual billing shows $89, $179 and $269 monthly equivalents. Each edition includes one system-administrator named user, two sales channels and unlimited orders/transactions. Additional users and channels need a quote. A storefront theme can have a one-time charge. Platform transaction allowances do not establish payment-processor costs.
sections.zh: 三个版本公布的月付价依次为 $99、$199、$299；年付月均价为 $89、$179、$269。每版含一个系统管理员实名用户、两个销售渠道及不限量订单和交易；额外用户与渠道需询价，店铺主题可能一次性收费。平台交易额度并不代表支付处理费用。

sections.title_en: Use the trial to check operational exceptions
sections.en: The vendor offers a 30-day trial without a card and says the trial instance can be converted to a paid edition. A multichannel retailer or wholesaler can use it to check partial receipts, stock adjustments and accounting handoff. A business needing only a simple stock list should compare this suite’s setup effort with narrower tools. Offline operation, connector failure recovery and export completeness were not tested.
sections.zh: 厂商提供无需信用卡的 30 天试用，并表示可将试用实例转为付费版本。多渠道零售商或批发商可借此检查部分收货、库存调整及会计交接。仅需简单库存清单的企业应比较套件配置成本与更窄工具。离线作业、连接失败恢复和完整导出尚未测试。
